task: Qualitative QB no-projection mosaic requested by user; no performance experiment or model selection
roi_basis: Approximate screenshot extent; Dongguk campus, Chungmuro and Jangchung area identified visually in the source image. Pixel ROI is authoritative; georeferencing not certified.

model.calibration: experiment 82 scene-mode, one frozen coefficient vector across the whole mosaic ROI

normalization: DN/4095 no input or output clipping

tiling.blend: separable half-sample Hann positive weights; normalize accumulated weights

display.stretch: global ROI LMS channelwise 2-98 percentile shared by input and output

outputs: float32 B G R NIR DN TIFF without certified georeferencing
